risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI & Autonomous Technologies Deployment, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Harm from Unauthorized / Unintended Product or Service Use (R-SC-5), Unintended or Unsafe Technology Behavior (R-AI-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Configuration Management Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of configuration management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Deployment (AAT-35) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
